mapper.select: SELECT cand_id FROM tb_hr_cand WHERE cand_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT skill_nm FROM tb_hr_cand_skill WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY skill_nm FOR UPDATE
SELECT cntc_sn FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY cntc_sn FOR UPDATE

SELECT jsonb_build_object('candidate',to_jsonb(c), 'skills',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.skill_nm) FROM tb_hr_cand_skill s WHERE s.cand_id=c.cand_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'contacts',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.cntc_sn) FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc t WHERE t.cand_id=c.cand_id),'[]'::jsonb))::text FROM tb_hr_cand c WHERE c.cand_id=#{id}
